Frozen base commit: `a748b01de5b7f29dfdd5eb19dadb40881ae4b8ca`. Checked: `2026-10-01T21:10:02.186804Z`.

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-01T20:58:00Z: [https://uralsib.ru/favicon.svg](https://uralsib.ru/favicon.svg); asset [https://uralsib.ru/favicon.svg](https://uralsib.ru/favicon.svg). Retrieved via the helper's packaged-CA retry \(Russian Trusted Root CA from gu-st.ru, receipt \[local artifact not published; reference omitted\]\); TLS verification never disabled. Details: Monogram strokes and white tile identical between working, optimized and official source; no detail loss at 240px.. Proportions: Monogram centered in the tile; proportions preserved; renders show no stretching or clipping..

Source-to-final transformations:
- SVGO 4.1.0 with the repository svgo.config.mjs \(config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e\), multipass; 1588 -\> 1197 bytes; optimized bytes selected as the final candidate \(sha256 26e89f27fc8a4ac1e6d1601996e19d46ee538c23c05e7231f39e618f681e1f8c\). Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-01T21:09:50.058475931Z`. Source/final: Official source reference and final SVG are visually identical \(same monogram geometry and color\) on light and dark reference canvases.; base/final and rendering: Offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource light and dark 240px frames: final renders the white tile with purple monogram cleanly on both backgrounds \(tile transparent-fill edge shows only on dark\); no clipping, distortion or color invention; base shows the superseded blue-disc emblem.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — The local Android SDK installation lacks the emulator component and system images, so a headless Android check is impossible this run. Risk: the Android Compose render path is unobserved..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same missing emulator prerequisites; not run. Risk: native Android path unobserved..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS runtime on this Linux host; not run. Risk: iOS Compose path unobserved..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain on this Linux host; not run. Risk: native iOS path unobserved..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
